counterexamples:

    equality therefore cannot implement W0/W1 parity.

    roadmap's emitter row appears available, but the guide creates stage1 together
    with src/index.ts, which the current contract reserves until public naming is accepted.
  - >-
    An ordinary new feature edge requires owner-local declaration/factory work,
    an own-profile change, stage0 assembly, and eventually an allowlist entry;
    this tree contains no executable workflow proving those edits remain bounded
    or diagnosable.

      research/implementation-readiness/report.md:283-292
    reproduction: >-
      Accepted ADR-0008 requires exact W0/W1 equality. The guide and report state
      that raw source bytes are unsuitable and require path-independent canonical
      tuples, extraction rules, and emitter normalization, but the exact tree
      contains no such artifact or executable checker.
    minimalCorrection: >-
      Define one versioned canonical wiring tuple schema, deterministic stage0
      extractor, stage1 extractor or emitter projection, and mutation suite before
      implementing the parity gate. Keep raw generated bytes as secondary evidence.
    productOwnerDecisionRequired: false
  - severity: "P2"
    location: >-
      docs/architecture/mvp-implementation-roadmap.md:90-95;
      docs/architecture/current-contract.md:111-120;
      docs/architecture/self-composition-implementation-guide.md:440-469
    reproduction: >-
      The roadmap lists separate M3 gates: ADR-0009/ADR-0012 for the public barrel
      and ADR-0016 for the emitter/generated stage1. The current contract permits
      only stage0-entry before public naming is accepted, while the guide requires
      generated stage1 and the public src/index.ts to appear in the same delivery.
      The texts do not determine whether private generated-stage qualification can
      proceed when ADR-0016 is accepted first.
    minimalCorrection: >-
      State explicitly whether all M3 gates are conjunctive. If private stage1
      qualification may precede public naming, define a private generated-subject
      entry independent of src/index.ts; otherwise list ADR-0009 and ADR-0012 as
      prerequisites of generated stage1 too.
    productOwnerDecisionRequired: false
